name: 72-project-sources-details
body:
[72-project-sources-details] Active sources decide

Desired behavior
Named system + read instructions first; tools called by their current schema.

Executable contract
1. New work or area → governing instructions, needed project sources, available skills by name/description. Minimal sufficient set incl. mandatory + explicitly requested.
2. Selected skill read before the work it governs; references at the step needing them. Workflow, gates, role permissions, handoffs followed. Description = discovery, never a substitute for the instruction.
3. Needed tool's current schema + the source's deciding conditions/exceptions checked; missing part of truncated output obtained when it affects the decision. Unknown/version-specific interface → installed code, schema or primary docs.
4. Capability or mandatory workflow unavailable → exact gap named. Allowed equivalent preserves the property, proves nothing about the original mechanism. Mandatory open gate reported; accessible authorized work continued.

Tools and skills
read/grep/glob/bash, skill loader, current MCP schema - per source. Detailed snapshot of 73 skills/116 tools: docs/standing-rules/04-bindings.md; it does not confirm current installation or execution. Skills re-selected on a material activity change.

Links: 01-operating-principle, 74-use-context-frontier, 75-evidence-or-blocker, 80-independent-review.

Anti-patterns
Familiarity instead of reading a mandatory skill; invented tool/API; neighboring product instead of the named one; unrelated skills bulk-loaded; gate silently skipped or false pass.
